name: Tesco
notes: Revenue = statutory turnover/revenue excluding VAT, including fuel (not 'Group sales' incl. VAT). Operating income = statutory operating profit/(loss) from continuing operations (not adjusted/trading profit); includes impairments, hence FY2015 loss of -5,792. FY2000-FY2004 UK GAAP (op profit before goodwill amortisation in AR2007 five-year record for FY2003-04); FY2005+ IFRS. Discontinued-ops restatements: FY2016+ excludes Korea (sold 2015); FY2020+ excludes Thailand, Malaysia and Poland; FY2023 restated in FY24 prelims (IFRS 17 and Banking operations discontinued). Year ends last Saturday of Feb (52/53 weeks).
